english_documents.title: DeepSeek Harness Community ecosystem
english_documents.summary: The community project is not a fork of DeepSeek Harness and not another Agent Runtime. The official DeepSeek Harness Runtime remains the only execution core. Community repositories add distribution, compatibility, plugins, knowledge, diagnostics, and experiments around it.

english_documents.title: The five-layer model: making dsh controllable
english_documents.summary: People often start by memorizing commands, model names, and tool names. What makes an agent task controllable is whether five layers line up: is the task clear, are the boundaries locked, are the capabilities really loaded, is the state explainable, and can the orchestration recover?
keywords: The five-layer model: making dsh controllable
1. Instruction: turn “make it good” into a task contract
2. Constraint: keep the action space recoverable
4. Memory: treat a session as state, not a chat window
5. Orchestration: connect observation, action, verification, and recovery

english_documents.title: What is dsh?
english_documents.summary: DeepSeek Harness, commonly invoked as dsh, is an open-source harness for running agent tasks. It assembles model requests, tools, workspaces, sessions, permissions, approvals, and a user interface into a sustained task instead of returning only a single chat response.
keywords: It is not just a one-shot model call
